statement: Section 10.2's prohibition on a confirmation item being 'inspected' means model exposure and any outcome-correlated inspection. Contamination screening is a pure-text, zero-model-call determination of an item property that is uncorrelated with any result. Not doing it now would mean it could only be done after unblinding.

consequence.action: run the identical 13-gram plus cosine dual-channel screen over all 300 confirmation items now
consequence.thresholds: the values frozen at P-0, used unchanged; they may not be adjusted
consequence.confirmation_items_otherwise_untouched: not tokenized, not prefilled, not generated from, not scored, not read for content beyond the screen

exclusion_policy_identical_for_both_spli.rule: a hit on either channel excludes the item from the primary analysis set
exclusion_policy_identical_for_both_spli.confirmatory_reporting_requirement: the confirmatory stage reports a with-and-without comparison over that sensitivity set

reporting_requirement.why: so a reader can judge for themselves whether a hit is substantive reuse or shared LaTeX boilerplate, rather than taking the flag on trust

limitation_wording.required: In an item-paired difference design contamination is primarily a CEILING risk: it lifts every arm equally and compresses the difference between them.
limitation_wording.why: the paired design differences out an item-level effect that is common to all arms; describing it as a threat to validity would overstate what a shared n-gram can do to a within-item contrast

claim_ceiling: The overlap rate is an item property reported alongside any accuracy figure. It is not evidence about J-space, about distillation, or about reasoning.
